import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/birnam-74v-costs');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from unboxed_numeric_timing_common import source
prior=json.loads((root/'docs/measurements/74v-unboxed-exploratory-timing.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(prior['floor']['path'])==prior['floor']['sha256']
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in prior['installed_sha256'].items())
work=Path('/tmp/birnam-74v-profile');work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
lines=source(32).splitlines(keepends=True)
fixture=work/'profile.birnam';fixture.write_text(''.join(lines[:-1])+'[12 timesRepeat: [|\n'+lines[-1]+']];\n')
result=dict(scope='Diagnostic native stack samples after the first measurement batch; no timing or qualification claim',floor=prior['floor'],installed_sha256=prior['installed_sha256'],fixture=fixture.read_text(),fixture_sha256=sha(fixture),rows=[])
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('BIRNAM_','DYLD_'))}
env.update(BIRNAM_ID_DYLIB=prior['floor']['path'],BIRNAM_TEST_UNBOXED_NUMERIC='1',BIRNAM_NUMERIC_SHAPE='0',BIRNAM_NUMERIC_BATCHES='500')
for enabled in [0,1]:
 env['BIRNAM_DEV_UNBOXED_NUMERIC']=str(enabled)
 output=work/f'{enabled}.log';profile=work/f'{enabled}.sample'
 argv=[str(Path(prior['prefix'])/'bin/birnam'),str(fixture)]
 with output.open('w') as handle:
  process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=handle,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  while process.poll() is None and 'unboxed-measure ' not in output.read_text():time.sleep(.1)
  assert process.poll() is None, output.read_text()
  identity=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(process.pid),'-o','pid=,lstart=,command='],text=True)
  assert str(fixture) in identity
  print('sampling owned child',process.pid,'enabled',enabled,flush=True)
  sampled=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sample',str(process.pid),'3','1','-file',str(profile)],text=True,capture_output=True)
  exit_code=process.wait()
 assert exit_code==0,output.read_text()
 assert sampled.returncode==0 and profile.exists(),(sampled.stdout,sampled.stderr)
 assert output.read_text().count('unboxed-measure ')==12
 result['rows'].append(dict(enabled=enabled,argv=argv,pid=process.pid,identity=identity,exit_code=exit_code,sample_exit_code=sampled.returncode,sample=profile.read_text(),output=output.read_text()))
 (work/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('profile completed enabled',enabled,flush=True)
assert sha(prior['floor']['path'])==prior['floor']['sha256']
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in prior['installed_sha256'].items())
result['status']='passed';(work/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
